explication: ImageGlass is a cross-platform photo viewer with image browsing, rendering, and focused editing tools. The principal workflow is launching a platform app, opening and navigating images, decoding and caching them, then displaying them in the viewer; users can also save or print images and use built-in or external tools. The tree and README establish broad capabilities, while sampled source supports only selected implementation links. Dashed edges mark relationships not verified in the excerpts or source index.
